notes.title: Update 1.0.4 Nov 27, 2023
notes.content:
• Fixed an issue that occurred when turning while using a controller.
• Fixed a rotation issue that occurred when turning while moving at low velocity.
• Animation bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 Nov 10, 2023
notes.content:
• Adjusted knock-down parameters.
• Reintroduced: cherry bomb ability, originally in alpha.
• Mapped dodge to their own buttons, in addition to the jump button.
• Fixed spectating bug.
• Minor bug fixes and adjustments.
Tutorial page has been made more accessible.
